primary_endpoint: Part 1: TEAEs and pegozafermin pharmacokinetics through Day 29 (with follow-up up to 113 days); Part 2: histologic NAS improvement without worsening fibrosis at Day 141 and TEAEs through 162 days.
efficacy_outcome: In Part 2, 12 participants receiving pegozafermin 27 mg QW met the histologic response criterion at Day 141; no comparator result was reported.
safety_signal: TEAEs occurred in 4–8 participants across Part 1 pegozafermin groups and in 8 placebo participants; Part 2 had 18 participants with TEAEs. Serious AEs occurred in 1/14 and 1/9 participants in the Part 1 18 mg Q2W and 36 mg Q2W groups, respectively; none were reported in other listed groups, and there were no deaths.
